dct_description_sm: In the published  report, they describe a Theano-based AlexNet (Krizhevsky et al., 2012) implementation and its naive data parallelism on multiple GPUs. Their performance on 2 GPUs is comparable with the state-of-art Caffe library (Jia et al., 2014) run on 1 GPU. To the best of their knowledge, this is the first open-source Python-based AlexNet implementation to-date.
